vibe_rationale: Deep, community-born surf and custom-moto core with multi-format programming, but brand-owned by Deus, so narrower and more commercial than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Post-heat recovery, hydration or wellness roles suit a surf crowd, but Deus owns the event, so access is a direct brand-to-brand deal. Australians were the largest source of Bali arrivals in 2025 (23.44 per cent, BPS Bali), so reach is plausible but the event share is unpublished.
